name: Kawamura Minoru
source:
An extremely hot-blooded Physical Education teacher who always smells like sweat.
Of course, I don't miss the students who dye his hair.
During his school days, he was unable to find a girlfriend because of rumors that he was gay. In general, he has a sad past.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20001018095504/http://www1.odn.ne.jp/d-xx/lineup/gizen/chara.htm]official website[/url].]
